title: Anvil artifact (schema version 1)
description: Metadata for one bounded, hashed artifact attached to a run. Content is stored separately; artifacts carry SHA-256 hashes. Default maximum size is 8 MiB (enforced by ingest, not by this schema).

name.description: Artifact file name. MUST be a plain name, not a path.

content_type.description: IANA media type of the artifact content.

event_id.description: Event that produced this artifact, when known.
